items.title: OpenVPN Vulnerability Exposes Linux, macOS Systems to Script Injection Attacks
items.description: A new vulnerability in early versions of OpenVPN has been disclosed, potentially allowing malicious servers to execute arbitrary commands on client machines. The flaw affects OpenVPN releases from 2.7_alpha1 to 2.7_beta1, enabling script-injection attacks on POSIX-based systems such as Linux, macOS, and BSD variants. The issue stems from inadequate sanitization of the –dns and –dhcp-option […]…
